استمطرتا (form X)
# اِسْتَمْطَرَتَا (istamṭaratā) /is.tam.tˤa.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
# اُسْتُمْطِرَتَا (ustumṭiratā) /us.tum.tˤi.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
